channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terry Rozier | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terry Rozier from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Bontemps on the Rozier situation:

“I think if they believe that Terry Rozier were not able to be traded, they would just use the roster spot on somebody else. I think the fact he's on the roster leaves open a pretty decent possibility that now maybe they will find a trade they like [or] maybe they cut him the next day and then they go after the trade deadline to go do something else with the roster spot. But my hunch is that if they find a deal they like, it'll probably work out.”

Tim Bontemps on Terry Rozier, Dec 9, 2025. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Chauncey Billups, Terry Rozier
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Billy Donovan on yday’s Chauncey Billups + Terry Rozier arrests:

“I was really, really surprised when that stuff came out. Certainly expect that everybody’s innocent until proven guilty.… obviously respected (Billups) as a player and winning a championship and all the things he’s accomplished as a player, and the job he was doing in Portland. Just surprised and saddened by all of it. “I’m sure we don’t have all the details, there’s probably more to come out. But it’s just sad that they’re dealing with that personally as human beings and that the league is dealing with that as well.”

Billy Donovan on Chauncey Billups, Terry Rozier, Oct 24, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Terry Rozier, Jalen Green
item.description:
crew chief Mark Davis said in the pool report.

“Herro responds and they are both ejected for fighting fouls. Green is ejected as his actions escalated the altercation. Rozier as well is ejected as his actions were escalators to the altercation. Coach Sullivan is assessed a technical foul and ejected for his unsportsmanlike comments directed at me as I was attempting to redirect [Alperen] Şengün.”

Tyler Herro on Terry Rozier, Jalen Green, Dec 30, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler, Terry Rozier, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Herro told me in an exclusive interview.

“It may look a little different, but we have young guys that we hope will continue to get better. Bam Adebayo and I are young guys who are starting to become full-fledged veterans in this league. Terry Rozier is healthy now and ready to compete. Then you have Jimmy Butler, who is extra motivated after not being able to play in the playoffs last season.”

Tyler Herro on Jimmy Butler, Terry Rozier, Bam Adebayo, Aug 20, 2024. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Andy Elisburg on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Andy Elisburg on the Heat offseason:

“Our free agent move this year was the Terry Rozier move. We just decided to do it early... Probably took us out of being able to do something with the mid-level, with sign-and-trades because of the apron rules that prevent that.”

Andy Elisburg on Terry Rozier, Jul 15, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Rozier, who was with the Boston Celtics at the time, requested Wade’s jersey two months before that moment actually happened following a game between the Heat and Celtics.

“I got a text at 4 in the morning from Terry Rozier,”

Dwyane Wade on Terry Rozier, Mar 29, 2024. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on the Heat's acquisition of Terry Rozier:

“I think Terry is already a native of Miami so I think it definitely made sense. So I’m happy for him, he kind of fits in (to what) their culture represents.”

Jaylen Brown on Terry Rozier, Jan 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Kevin Love on Terry Rozier
item.description:
“Playing 8 and a half years in Cleveland, that being where [Terry Rozier's] from, he used to light us up... He can certainly put points up in a hurry.”

Kevin Love on Terry Rozier, Jan 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Terry Rozier
item.description:
“In his two seasons with the Hornets, Terry Rozier has been an instrumental part of our team,”

Mitch Kupchak on Terry Rozier, Aug 24, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: James Borrego on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Hornets coachJames Borrego on Terry Rozier's playing time tonight:

“He wants to play heavy minutes, and I want him to, but I've got to make sure he looks right.”

James Borrego on Terry Rozier, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Stevens on Rozier:

“Every minute he played felt impactful,and we all know what he can do when he’s given more opportunity.”

Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier, Apr 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Jay King:Dave Joerger on Kyrie sitting:

“Last time it happened Terry Rozier put 34 on us last year.”

Dave Joerger on Terry Rozier, Mar 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kyrie Irving, Terry Rozier
item.description:
Steve Bulpett:Brad Stevens on @Terry Rozier starting in place of Kyrie Irving (tight quad) at Brooklyn:

“Yeah, Terry's great. Terry will be ready. He'll be ready to play tonight.”

Brad Stevens on Kyrie Irving, Terry Rozier, Jan 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @SteveBHoop.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kyrie Irving, Terry Rozier
item.description:
Scott Souza:#Celtics coach Brad Stevens on starting Terry Rozier in place of Kyrie Irving (eye):

“Clearly, he’s deserved that with all that he’s done here over the last three years. And anytime that he’s started he’s played really well. You feel comfortable with him. That’s a no-brainer.”

Brad Stevens on Kyrie Irving, Terry Rozier, Jan 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @Scott_Souza.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier’s recent struggles:

“He'll get through this and he'll be great, because of who he is.”

Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Stevens on Rozier:

“I think it’s very clear how all of us players, coaches and front office, people in Boston, everybody you run into, how they feel about Terry. And it’d be great if we could have him here for a long, long, time.”

Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier, Oct 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Ty Lue on Rozier’s growth:

“I thought he was a throwback player. He used to come in the game, play with pace and speed. Now he’s taken it to a whole other level.”

Tyronn Lue on Terry Rozier, May 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Celtics:Stevens on the importance of chippiness to Rozier's game:

“I think it's a big part of who he is. I think he's a competitive guy. I think he's a tough guy, and he does a great job of balancing that chip by playing with poise.”

Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier, May 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Al Horford, Kevin Love, Brad Stevens, Terry Rozier, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Paul Pierce:

“If you look down, I’ll take [Al] Horford over Kevin Love. The way Tatum’s been playing, Rozier, nobody on Cleveland is playing as well as those guys and they have the advantage pretty much every night at coaching.“Ty Lue’s a great coach but Brad Stevens is the best coach in basketball right now. No offence to [San Antonio Spurs coach Gregg] Popovich, but he’s the best coach in the NBA and that says a lot. “Look at what he’s doing with the Celtics. If they end up in the Finals? Come on. “We had them written off to not even make the playoffs or go this far in the playoffs without Gordon [Hayward] or Kyrie [Irving].”

Paul Pierce on Al Horford, Kevin Love, Brad Stevens, Terry Rozier, Jayson Tatum, May 9, 2018. Source: The Daily Express.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Joel Embiid on his confrontation with Terry Rozier:

“He tried to punch me twice. Too bad he's too shortand couldn't get to my face.”

Joel Embiid on Terry Rozier, May 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I’m excited about the playoffs. I really am. Like, Terry Rozier and Shane Larkin, this is their opportunity. And Jaylen [Brown] and Jayson [Tatum] and Marcus Morris and [Al] Horford and [Aron] Baynes and Greg Monroe, I mean, the whole group. These guys are looking forward to playing in the playoffs. And we have the luxury to give them a little bit of rest without taking them completely out of rhythm in these last four games, which is very rare to be able to do heading into the playoffs.”

Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Marcus Smart, Terry Rozier
item.description:
“You can feel the energy here at our practice facility,you can see it in guys that are trying out for the [G-League], guys that are going to play major roles on our team this year, young and old, you can just see the energy that exists around here and it’s good. It’s exciting. I’m excited to get the season started and see how it all works. “I think Terry [Rozier] and Marcus [Smart] are really ready to step up,”

Danny Ainge on Marcus Smart, Terry Rozier, Sep 18, 2017. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Al Horford on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Al Horford:

“I didn't expect a guy like Terry Rozier to have so much improvement from when we saw him in the playoffs until now.”

Al Horford on Terry Rozier, Oct 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: RJ Hunter on Terry Rozier
item.description:
“Jordan can just flat-out play. He has a motor. He's smart. He works hard. He makes the right plays. And he's going to be a star. I think the same with Terry (Rozier, the No. 16 overall pick). Terry, obviously the talent's there. The speed's there. And once he figures out this game, I think he'll be a perennial All-Star. The draft class that the Celtics brought in besides me is unbelievable. I think those guys can really play.”

RJ Hunter on Terry Rozier, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: RJ Hunter on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Jay King:Hunter on conversation with Rozier:

“It hasn't really hit us yet (that they're in the NBA). I guess that means it's time to get to work.”

RJ Hunter on Terry Rozier, Jun 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier:

“He's a favorite of Danny's. We think he's a really special talent. I'm excited about Terry. You'll enjoy watching him.”

Brad Stevens on Terry Rozier, Jun 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.
